title: Founder and CEO, Ryan Petersen of Flexport speaks at Xeneta Summit, Munich 2026.
summary: Takeaways from Ryan Petersen's keynote at Xeneta Summit in Munich: how data, AI, people and infrastructure help shippers decide faster.
body_markdown:
---


Article


Ryan Petersen, Flexport's founder and CEO, took the stage at Xeneta Summit in Munich (4 and 5 November) to explain how tech, artificial intelligence (AI) and the human factor help shippers make faster supply chain decisions. His message is that AI makes data easier to trust and helps people decide faster. People still make the final call, because they know the customer, the shipment and the context that data alone misses.


Supply chains waste "close to $2 trillion, maybe a little bit over" every year, much of it because planning still runs on spreadsheets and quarterly forecasts. "You're not able to feed real time data," Ryan says. "The more data that you can give in, the better your forecasting is going to get."
